description: This file defines the Title class for handling chart titles in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages the title caption, layout, and overlay properties, providing methods to get and set these attributes.

classes.name: Title
classes.description: Class representing the title of a chart, including caption, layout, and overlay options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Title with optional caption, layout, and overlay settings.

methods.name: getCaption
methods.description: Returns the caption of the title, which can be a string, array, or RichText object.

methods.name: getCaptionText
methods.description: Returns the caption as plain text regardless of its internal representation.

methods.name: setCaption
methods.description: Sets the caption of the title.

methods.name: getOverlay
methods.description: Checks if overlay of other elements is allowed.

methods.name: setOverlay
methods.description: Sets whether overlay of other elements is allowed.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout configuration for the title.
